ModMetaData.name: Unique Melee Weapons
ModMetaData.author: Sam Hunt
ModMetaData.description: Odyssey's unique weapons are all guns. This mod adds seven stuffable unique melee weapons: knife, gladius, longsword, spear and mace, plus axe and warhammer with Royalty. Each rolls its own material, art variant, colours, name and traits from a pool of 28+ built for melee. Includes a tribal warband quest for acquisition. Requires Odyssey.
